interpretation: Point/pair MSE and a finite unseen-family move-choice screen do not establish playing strength.
loss_definition: point teacher MSE + 1.0 * sibling teacher gap MSE + 4.0 * old-TRAIN frozen-warm-prediction MSE; all normalized by10000 for gradients

integer_step_control.acceptance: First scale with finite objective <= current objective; otherwise skip
integer_step_control.adam_moments_policy: Update moments and optimizer step once per proposal, including skipped proposals; scale only the bounded parameter delta
integer_step_control.objective: Full TRAIN integer point MSE + all-pair gap MSE + preservation_weight*old-TRAIN warm-output MSE

selection.pair_batch_policy: Shuffle each family and family order with the training seed; round-robin families, split across point batches; each pair once per epoch

preservation_targets.batch_policy: Full old-TRAIN preservation mean in every point/pair minibatch
preservation_targets.source: Frozen epoch-zero deployed-integer white-CP outputs on old TRAIN inputs only
